title: Indoor CO2 Overnight Ventilation Gap
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airgradient:sensor
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=0 AND hour<6
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(co2_ppm) as avg_co2_ppm, max(co2_ppm) as max_co2_ppm by room _time
| where avg_co2_ppm>1200 OR max_co2_ppm>1800
| sort - avg_co2_ppm
description: Uses AirGradient indoor air data telemetry to monitor overnight CO2 buildup in sleeping spaces in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for ventilation problems that affect sleep quality and comfort, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AirGradient indoor air data data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily room chart of overnight average and max CO2.
grandmaExplanation: It records overnight CO2 buildup in sleeping spaces so you can spot ventilation problems that affect sleep quality and comfort before it becomes annoying.
